approved: Business Services Wage Assessment Tool Payment Scheme (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2014
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that would create a payment scheme for workers with cognitive disabilities whose pay was set by a specific assessment tool at Australian Disability Enterprises.

The package would adjust several Commonwealth laws, including tax and social security rules, so payments are treated as lump sum arrears for tax purposes and are not counted as income for welfare payments.
Eligible workers would need to register by 1 May 2015 and submit applications by 30 November 2015, with payments possible from July 2014.
The bill would amend tax law so payments are eligible for the lump sum in arrears tax offset.
It would change social security law and the Veterans’ Entitlements Act 1986 to exclude payments from income testing, preventing reductions in income support.
It would adjust confidentiality provisions in social security law to allow sharing of personal information for administering the scheme.
Supported employees with intellectual impairment at Australian Disability Enterprises whose wages were set by the Business Services Wage Assessment Tool, and their families and carers.
